evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivered the 10-15 minute time-boxed ask with promise of dependable quote and explicit wait for a yes. Instead moved directly into data gathering after asking if 'this is a good time.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep launched straight into logistics probing without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (2-story house and 1-story destination), floor/stories, storage location, parking, oversized items (toolbox), fragile items (Christmas things), box count estimate (~100). Additional stops picked up (storage unit + house). Comprehensive probing.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes — 'Just an estimate in terms of number of boxes. Do you have a number? Do you think it's about a hundred including, including the totes?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Yes, anchored by typical 7-9 hour load time for 26-foot truck plus travel considerations. Personalized by customer's two-stop setup and travel time to Kyle. Two estimates given: $2,598 (3 guys, 7.5-8.5 hrs) and $1,878 (2 guys, 9 hrs).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Trip fee disclosed ($150 travel fee from Kyle to Leander branch). Hourly rate detailed ($96/mover, $192 for two). Two-and-a-half-hour minimum disclosed with 15-minute increment charging. All inclusions explained (truck, wraps, assembly/disassembly, taxes, insurance, credit card fees).
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After presenting estimates, rep said 'Any questions so far?' and customer responded with their own concern (cost comparison to renting a truck themselves). No 'does that feel fair' + silence moment.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. 'On time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts by the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full. 'No worries damage coverage. Which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any repair replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.' Framed as included, no deductible/fine print language present.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep mentioned both promises but did not ask a closing question like 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm customer acceptance of the guarantees.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call ended without a genuine 'What's still concerning you?' check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No. Never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Softened with out. 'Now if that's all good with you guys would you like our help on the fifteenth but as I've mentioned right now I, my recommendation is really three guys just to make things quicker...' — phrased as conditional agreement rather than direct 'Would you like our help?' and bundled with a recommendation pivot.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No language about rate-locking or holding the quote.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Date (October 15) and phone number confirmed earlier in call. Crew size discussed (2 vs 3) but not finalized. Arrival window not confirmed. Addresses confirmed (storage, house pickup, Kyle destination). No notes left for crew about customer concerns (they mentioned not having fragile items but rep didn't circle back to document that for the crew).

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details across two pickup locations and one destination with excellent follow-up on storage unit fill-level, parking constraints, and furniture specifics — this probing was thorough and will generate an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: You skipped the critical 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' question in Section 2 and jumped straight to logistics probing — this cost you discovery of the customer's real pain points and left the call without a final concerns check, rate lock, or a clean close. Always start with their agenda before gathering details.
